correctness.rationale: The universal proof identifies the parity-induced surface by its explicit facets, one boundary cycle, vertex links and Euler characteristic, then classifies all retractions by an exhaustive symbolic transition table. Direct substitution verifies the three survivors, and \(r\circ j=\operatorname{id}\) gives the homology splitting. The bundled verifier reproduces representative finite cases without being used as an infinite proof.
